The '''Imperial Second Division''' was a [[Division/Legends|division]] of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was deployed on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] under the orders of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Zaster]]. During this time, Zaster was very concerned about the expansion of the criminal group known as the [[Alkhara Bandits]]. General Zaster eventually sent an official notice to all Imperial personnel on Tatooine in order to reinforce patrols in the areas concerned by the Bandits' activities.<ref name="SWG:SC" />
